chapters.text: There's a myth about small bags. They hold a phone and a lipstick, and everything else gets left at home or squeezed into a second bag. So you end up carrying two bags for one day.
Not this one. Open the snap flap and the inside is organized, with room for your phone, wallet and keys, all in their own spot.
Watch them go in. Phone first, then the wallet, then the keys. Each one has its own place, so nothing sinks to the bottom and you never have to dig for anything.
Then one press on the clasp and it snaps shut with one hand. Everything stays in, and you keep walking.
Outside, it's a structured, vintage-style bag that stays timeless. And the strap is adjustable, so it's a handbag in the morning and a crossbody by the afternoon.
So the next time someone tells you small means less, show them what fits.
